The user wants to set the log level of `svc-ember-524` to `debug` and check the size of bucket `bucket-events-6990`.
According to the runbook (`/runbooks/ops.md`):
1. Read `/workspace/ticket-TCK-793510.txt` (Done).
2. GET `/api/services/svc-ember-524` (Current status).
3. POST `/api/tickets/TCK-793510/token` for a token.
4. POST `/api/services/svc-ember-524/log-level` with `level: debug` and the token.
5. Call `cloud_stat` for `bucket-events-6990`.
6. Submit report.

The next step is step 2: GET `/api/services/svc-ember-524`.
